ChangeNotes.Value: Changelog - Fixed a problem with desertions affecting players using older saves. - Removed a hitch when starting a battle. - Fixed a crash when joining an in-progress battle. - Trading companions between players now updates clans correctly. - Multiplayer traffic now uses fewer bytes, reducing network bandwidth usage. - Gameplay now pauses automatically when everyone leaves the campaign map. - Fixed a client crash after mounted troops died in field battles. - Fixed building construction in settlements. - City and castle management windows now retain building queues when reopened. - Returning from Alt+Tab no longer prevents the encyclopedia from opening. - Hero names now apply correctly after tabbing back, preventing new heroes from remaining nameless. - Fixed battle rewards for the player who starts a battle when another player joins later. - Mercenary players can now join and leave kingdoms correctly. - Fixed mismatched daily gold changes between clients and the server. - Fixed siege ladders desynchronizing between players. - Player parties no longer repeat campaign-map behavior calculations every frame and still enter and leave settlements normally. - Players can now leave or rejoin a siege after their health changes. - Purchasing many workshops no longer causes the Clan tab to display a black screen. - Rejoining a session now restores missing workshop details, allowing older saves to recover correctly. - Settlements containing owned workshops now retain complete warehouse lists, keeping clan stock views complete. - Players can now reach full workshop capacity without an owned settlement being dropped from storage.
